name: Hello Plugin (Swift)
summary: A compiled Swift template on the Vektor SDK: a command in the file menu and a small view in the sidebar.
description: Copy this folder, change the id (reverse domain, lowercase), the name and the publisher, edit Sources/HelloPlugin/HelloPlugin.swift and run ./build.sh. It uses the Vektor SDK for Swift. The compiled program needs nothing installed on the user's Mac. Run `vektor-plugin validate .` to check it, `vektor-plugin test . test/checks.json` to test it (or `swift run hello-check`), and load it in Vektor with Developer mode on (Settings ▸ Plugins ▸ Load Plugin from Folder…).

items.label: Greeting
